scheme_name: Dental Care Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Dental Care Scheme is an initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board in 2019. 

This scheme aims to provide dental care services to workers in the unorganized sector in Haryana. 

The primary objective of the Dental Care Scheme is to improve oral health among workers and their families. 

The scheme specifically targets the labour class, which often lacks access to adequate dental care facilities. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board recognizes the importance of oral health as a critical component of overall health. 

The scheme aims to reduce the incidence of dental diseases among workers by providing preventive and curative dental services. 

The Dental Care Scheme offers free dental check-ups and treatments to eligible beneficiaries. 

This includes services such as dental examinations, cleanings, fillings, extractions, and other necessary dental procedures. 

The scheme also covers the cost of dental medicines and materials required for treatment. 

Eligible beneficiaries can receive these services from designated dental clinics and hospitals across Haryana. 

The scheme is particularly beneficial for low-income workers who may not afford dental care otherwise. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is significant. 

Each beneficiary is entitled to receive dental treatment worth up to ₹5,000 per year. 

This amount is aimed at covering a wide range of dental services to ensure comprehensive care. 

The eligibility criteria for the Dental Care Scheme are specific and well-defined. 

Workers in the unorganized sector who are registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board are eligible. 

The age limit for beneficiaries is set at 18 years and above. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to avail of the benefits under this scheme. 

However, beneficiaries must provide proof of their employment in the unorganized sector. 

This can include documents such as a registration certificate from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The application process for the Dental Care Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested beneficiaries must fill out an application form available at the local Labour Welfare Board office. 

They must submit the application along with necessary documents such as identity proof and employment proof. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the officials at the Labour Welfare Board. 

Upon approval, beneficiaries receive a card that allows them to access dental services. 

The scheme is designed to be user-friendly and accessible to all eligible workers. 

The timeline for the application process is generally quick. 

Beneficiaries can expect to receive their approval within 15 to 30 days of application submission. 

The disbursement of benefits is done on a reimbursement basis. 

Beneficiaries must first avail of dental services from the designated clinics. 

They can then submit the bills and receipts to the Labour Welfare Board for reimbursement. 

The Dental Care Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

For more information or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official office. 

The contact details are available on the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website. 

The scheme has been positively received since its launch. 

It has significantly improved access to dental care among low-income workers in Haryana. 

Statistics indicate that over 10,000 workers have benefited from the scheme in its first year. 

The Haryana government has allocated a budget of ₹5 crore for the Dental Care Scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

This funding is aimed at expanding the reach of the scheme and improving dental health services. 

The government is also working on increasing awareness about the scheme among workers. 

Workshops and informational sessions are being conducted to educate workers about oral health. 

The Dental Care Scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance the welfare of workers in Haryana. 

It complements other welfare schemes aimed at improving health, education, and living standards. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is committed to ensuring that all workers have access to essential health services. 

The Dental Care Scheme is a vital step towards achieving this goal. 

The scheme not only addresses immediate dental health needs but also promotes preventive care. 

By providing free dental services, the scheme encourages workers to seek regular dental check-ups. 

This proactive approach is expected to lead to better overall health outcomes for workers and their families. 

The Dental Care Scheme is an essential component of Haryana's labour welfare initiatives. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the quality of life for workers in the unorganized sector. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over time based on feedback from beneficiaries. 

Continuous monitoring and evaluation will ensure that the scheme meets its objectives effectively. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is also exploring partnerships with private dental clinics. 

This would expand the network of service providers under the scheme. 

The aim is to ensure that beneficiaries have easy access to dental care across the state. 

Overall, the Dental Care Scheme is a significant welfare initiative. 

It addresses a critical gap in healthcare services for workers in Haryana. 

By focusing on dental health, the scheme contributes to the overall well-being of the workforce. 

The Haryana government remains dedicated to enhancing the health and welfare of its citizens. 

Through initiatives like the Dental Care Scheme, it aims to create a healthier and more productive workforce.
